title: S030 — Event-driven aggregate worklist / performance equivalence
description: Replace S029's reset-scope strategy with a genuine event-driven Phase-A worklist that recomputes only queued nodes via the authoritative per-node rule, and prove prefix-by-prefix equivalence.
result_summary: PASS. The event-driven worklist Phase A is exactly equivalent to the authoritative from-scratch Phase A: 10,000 prefixes (100 histories x H=20 + 30 histories x H=100, verrin + ordos), 0 mismatches (0.00%); TARGET == REF-A at every prefix. Implementation: seed the work queue with directChanged (S028 complete delta), pop a node, recompute via the AUTHORITATIVE nodeSupport (a refactor extracting the exact positiveFixpoint decision rule), and enqueue dependents only when the judgment actually changes. KEY METRIC: the worklist processes 0.94 nodes/step vs 15.76 model nodes (~6% of the model) - work proportional to actual change, not model size. Phase B unchanged. CLASSIFICATION: A - exact and materially incremental (S029 was O(model)/step; S030 is O(actual change)/step). HONEST CAVEAT: wall-clock timing NOT measured (only the node-count metric, which is the brief's key metric); S024 synthetic corpus and determinism/branch isolation not run.
minimum_persistent_state: previous Phase-A truth map + current model + the S028 dependency index + the work queue; intervention history NOT required
next_experiment: productionization/hardening of the incremental execution state lifecycle (checkpointing, rewind, branch copies, concurrency, API boundaries, observability) plus a wall-clock performance confirmation (p50/p95, sparse/medium/dense, H=100/1k/10k) and the S024 synthetic corpus, without changing semantics.
limitations: Wall-clock not measured; only the node-count metric.
S024 synthetic corpus not run; the randomized corpus is verrin + ordos only.
Determinism/branch isolation hold by construction but were not independently repeated.
The worklist uses a FIFO queue; different fair orders were not swept.
10,000 prefixes is a finite corpus; empirical, not a proof.
One src refactor (nodeSupport extraction) - semantics unchanged; 624/624 preserved.
